negativos.claim: modern LLM concepts that ch.12 does not contain
BERT/GPT-3: none of this on these pages
ch.18: names the book does not use
RLHF appears only in the note on p.412
ch.20 does not cover scaling laws or NTK
AdamW appears only in the notes (p.108)
the book says He initialization without the name Kaiming
BatchNorm on p.206-208; LayerNorm only in the notes p.217+
ch.21 cites GDPR art.22, not LGPD or the AI Act
the non-saturating variant is not covered on these pages
the cosine schedule is not in ch.6
ch.2 only has sigmoids and the 4 equations
NNDL does not cover transformers, diffusion or BatchNorm
NNDL does not use KL for the cross-entropy; it uses the dC/dw argument
NNDL initialization is 1/sqrt(n_in), without the name He
Adam does not appear among NNDL's SGD variations
ch.5 covers sigmoids and unstable gradients
